result.instruction: Keep the top interface and `// @latency 0` annotation, and replace the child instance with equivalent top-level state: registered `clean`, the prior `noisy` sample, and a 3-bit saturating LFSR counter. Map the counter states so reset, noisy transitions, and consecutive samples produce the same clean update cycle as the existing 8-sample behavior, including holding `clean` and the counter at saturation. Preserve synchronous active-high reset priority and verify that the routed result strictly improves LUT count while passing all simulation, timing, and metric gates.
